tweets: GHK-Cu: topical or injected? The evidence isn't equal in both routes. Let's break down where the research is strongest—and where it still leaves questions. 🧵
Topical GHK-Cu has more existing research, particularly in cosmetic applications. Much of the evidence comes from preliminary studies focused on skin appearance and related outcomes.
Injected GHK-Cu has limited human data available. Most findings come from animal research, which may not reliably translate to human clinical effects.
Our practice is building a model that routes GHK-Cu through physician supervision, labs, and follow-up—both for topical and injectable use, where clinically appropriate.
